name: PGVector
label: PGVector — Postgres similarity search
description: Generic pgvector node on a customer-owned PostgreSQL. Operations: QUERY (vector similarity when embedding is a number[]; substring match on the document column when embedding is empty), UPSERT, DELETE. Wire this to an AI Agent data FUNCTION port — the agent emits {operation:'QUERY', query, embedding?, topK, filter}. Password stays in configurationParameters and is never logged. Auth: trust, cleartext, MD5, SCRAM-SHA-256. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One vector-store operation. Do not put password here. Example: {"operation":"QUERY","query":"order 42","topK":5,"filter":{"source":"orders"}}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. Purpose: choose the SQL path. EXACT accepted values (case-insensitive): QUERY (similarity or text fallback) | UPSERT (insert/update one row) | DELETE (by id and/or filter). Any other token fails with error and does not connect. Example: 'QUERY'.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Free-text query. Purpose: when embedding is empty, QUERY uses position(query in document_column) > 0 (no ILIKE wildcards). On UPSERT, used as document when document is omitted. Accepted value: any string. Empty QUERY with no embedding and no filter returns the first topK rows. Example: 'invoice 8831 line items'.

schema.label: embedding
schema.description: Dense vector. Purpose: QUERY uses pgvector <=> cosine distance when this is a non-empty number[]; UPSERT requires it. Accepted values: number[] of finite floats. Nested [[...]] is flattened to one vector. Empty/omit on QUERY → text fallback. Do not log. Example: [0.12, -0.04, 0.88].

schema.label: topK
schema.description: Neighbor / row cap for QUERY (SQL LIMIT). Purpose: bound the result set. Accepted values: integers ≥ 1. Non-positive / blank → 5 (or config topK). Alias on input: limit. Example: 5.

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Metadata equality filter. Purpose: AND of metadata_column ->> key = value. Key 'id' compares the id column instead. Accepted value: JSON object of string keys to scalars. Empty {} → no extra predicate. Example: {"source":"orders"}.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Row id for UPSERT (required) or DELETE. Purpose: primary key. Accepted value: non-empty string. Empty on DELETE is allowed only when filter is non-empty. Example: 'doc-42'.

schema.label: document
schema.description: Text stored on UPSERT. Purpose: the retrieval document. Accepted value: any string. When omitted, input.query is used. Example: 'Order 42 is in bin A-12.'.

schema.label: metadata
schema.description: JSON object stored on UPSERT (jsonb). Purpose: filterable attributes. Accepted value: object (JSON-encoded) or a JSON string. Null → {}. Example: {"source":"orders","lang":"en"}.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', matches, data:{matches,value}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: matches
schema.description: QUERY/DELETE rows as {id, document?, metadata?, score?}. Purpose: AI Agent on-demand RAG data tools unwrap this list. Empty when no neighbors. Example: [{"id":"42","document":"Order 42 is in bin A-12","score":0.91}].

schema.label: data
schema.description: Same matches under data.matches and data.value so generic unwrap (data.value / matches) works. Never includes secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default verb when input.operation is blank. Purpose: instance default. EXACT accepted values: QUERY | UPSERT | DELETE. Required. Example: 'QUERY'.

configurationParameters.label: Host
configurationParameters.description: PostgreSQL hostname or IP. Purpose: TCP connect target. Accepted value: non-empty host. Default 127.0.0.1. Customer owns this endpoint. Example: '127.0.0.1'. Example: 'pg.prod.svc'.

configurationParameters.label: Port
configurationParameters.description: PostgreSQL port. Purpose: TCP connect. Accepted values: positive integers. Default 5432. ≤0 → 5432. Example: 5432.

configurationParameters.label: Database
configurationParameters.description: Database name in the startup message. Purpose: which catalog to open. Accepted value: non-empty identifier-like name. Default postgres. Example: 'app'.

configurationParameters.label: User
configurationParameters.description: PostgreSQL role. Purpose: startup user. Accepted value: non-empty. Default postgres. Example: 'sq_agent'.

configurationParameters.label: Password
configurationParameters.description: Role password. Purpose: cleartext, MD5, or SCRAM-SHA-256 after startup. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT, never logged, never returned. Blank is valid for trust auth. Example: bind a secret reference, not a literal.

configurationParameters.label: Schema
configurationParameters.description: Schema of the vector table. Purpose: quoted identifier. Accepted values: [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. Default public. Invalid tokens fail before connect. Example: 'public'.

configurationParameters.label: Table
configurationParameters.description: Vector table name. Purpose: FROM/INSERT/DELETE target. REQUIRED. Accepted values: [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. Empty fails with 'table is required'. Example: 'documents'.

configurationParameters.label: Id Column
configurationParameters.description: Primary-key column. Purpose: SELECT/UPSERT/DELETE id. Accepted values: [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. Default id. Example: 'id'.

configurationParameters.label: Document Column
configurationParameters.description: Text column retrieved and used for the no-embedding QUERY fallback. Accepted values: [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. Default document. Example: 'document'.

configurationParameters.label: Embedding Column
configurationParameters.description: pgvector column used with <=> on QUERY/UPSERT. Accepted values: [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. Default embedding. Example: 'embedding'.

configurationParameters.label: Metadata Column
configurationParameters.description: jsonb column for filter and UPSERT metadata. Accepted values: [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. Default metadata. Example: 'metadata'.

configurationParameters.label: Top K
configurationParameters.description: Default QUERY LIMIT when input.topK is missing or not a positive integer. Accepted values: integers ≥ 1. Default 5. Example: 5.

configurationParameters.label: Ssl Mode
configurationParameters.description: TLS to Postgres. Purpose: disable = plain TCP (default); require = SSLRequest then TLS. EXACT: disable | require. Example: 'disable'. Use require on any network that is not loopback.

configurationParameters.label: Verify Tls
configurationParameters.description: Certificate check when sslmode=require. Purpose: default true. EXACT: 'true' | 'false' (lab-only trust-all). Blank/other → true. Example: 'true'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read budget in seconds. Purpose: bound a hung Postgres. Accepted values: positive integers. Blank/0/negative → 25. Capped at 60. Example: 25.
